faqs.question: How do you get the details?
faqs.answer: We interview your team and review project notes, then shape an accurate, compelling story — you approve every claim before publishing.

faqs.question: Can you design the layout too?
faqs.answer: Yes — we can pair the writing with on-brand design for the web or a downloadable PDF.

faqs.question: Do you deliver in Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes — bilingual Arabic + English with full RTL support, so both audiences get a first-class experience.

faqs.question: Do we own the result?
faqs.answer: Completely. You keep the accounts, data, configurations, and documentation. There is no lock-in to CloudTopia.
